description: Locust plague — 80k agents, density-dependent phase shift from solitary (solitarious) to gregarious, aligned marching swarm.
reference: Buhl et al. 2006 (Science) — From Disorder to Order in Marching Locusts; Uvarov 1966
notes: The phase transition in Schistocerca gregaria is one of the most dramatic collective phenomena in nature. Below ~25/m² individuals avoid each other; above this density they align and march as one. The transition is hysteretic — an analogy to first-order magnetic phase transitions. Buhl et al. 2006 reproduced this computationally with the Vicsek model.
